relationships.subject: LI-cTBUS
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to controls, PCI mice exhibited elevated BDNF level, which was markedly reduced following 10 days of LI-cTBUS treatment (Fig. 3a).

relationships.subject: LI-cTBUS
relationships.evidence_quote: KCC2 protein expression in the ipsilateral side of dorsal spinal horn—suppressed in the PCI group—was restored to near-control levels by LI-cTBUS (Fig. 3b)

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF injection acutely lowered mechanical withdrawal thresholds, confirming its sufficiency to induce allodynia (Fig. 3c).

relationships.subject: LI-cTBUS
relationships.evidence_quote: LI-cTBUS substantially alleviated mechanical allodynia during and after treatment.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: suppresses KCC2 expression, leading to intracellular Cl− accumulation

key_findings: LI-cTBUS (0.77 W/cm2, 200 Hz) gave sustained relief of mechanical allodynia in PCI mice and reduced spinal BDNF while restoring KCC2 and chloride reversal potential
LI-cTBUS reduced reactive astrogliosis and astrocytic GABA, likely via TRPA1
